scientific limitations/integrity.integrity: The all-parameter classification is proved directly from the pendant-bundle obstruction and an exhaustive analysis of the single vertex of slack above that obstruction. The scalar minimum and graph propagation time are explicitly acknowledged as prior results rather than presented as new.
scientific limitations/integrity.limitations: The classification is restricted to generalized helms with \(m\ge3\) and \(s\ge2\). It does not classify nonminimum zero forcing sets and therefore does not determine the full zero forcing polynomial. Finite verification covers ten parameter pairs through order \(22\) and is not used as the infinite proof.

title: Minimum zero forcing sets of generalized helms
